requests.progress_stage_requested.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: waiting for someone to approve it.

requests.progress_stage_approved.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: approved, not downloading yet.

requests.progress_stage_queued.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: in the download queue, not started.

requests.progress_stage_downloading.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: the download is running.

requests.progress_stage_paused.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: the download is paused.

requests.progress_stage_finishing.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: all data is in, the download app is wrapping up.

requests.progress_stage_importing.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: the file is being moved into the library.

requests.progress_stage_imported.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: the file was added to the library.

requests.progress_stage_partial.value: Some episodes are in the library
requests.progress_stage_partial.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: part of a series is in the library.

requests.progress_stage_attention.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: the download app reported a problem. {app} is Radarr or Sonarr.

requests.progress_stage_failed.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: the download failed.

requests.progress_stage_declined.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: the request was declined.

requests.progress_stage_available.description: Requests area, progress. Where a request stands: ready to watch.

requests.progress_percent.description: Requests area, progress. A percentage. {n} is 0 to 100.

requests.progress_eta_soon.description: Requests area, progress. Time left: under a minute.

requests.progress_eta_minutes.description: Requests area, progress. Time left in minutes. {n} is the minutes.

requests.progress_eta_hours.description: Requests area, progress. Time left in hours and minutes. {h} is the hours, {m} the minutes.

requests.progress_eta_whole_hours.description: Requests area, progress. Time left in whole hours. {h} is the hours.

requests.progress_library_count.description: Requests area, progress. A series: how many episodes are in the library. {have} of {total}.

requests.progress_via_client.description: Requests area, progress. The download app doing the download. {client} is its name, as it reports it.

requests.progress_note_live.description: Requests area, progress. Where the numbers came from: read live. {app} is Radarr or Sonarr.

requests.progress_note_seerr.value: From Seerr, updated about once a minute
requests.progress_note_seerr.description: Requests area, progress. Where the numbers came from: Seerr only, which updates about once a minute.

requests.progress_note_age.description: Requests area, progress. The numbers are a little old. {n} is the seconds since the last update.

requests.progress_note_age_min.description: Requests area, progress. The numbers are old. {n} is the minutes since the last update.

requests.progress_note_offline.description: Requests area, progress. The app could not be reached. {app} is its name.

requests.progress_note_refused.value: {app} refused the connection. Check its key in Settings.
requests.progress_note_refused.description: Requests area, progress. The app turned the connection down, likely a wrong key. {app} is its name.

requests.progress_not_sent.description: Requests area, progress. Approved in Seerr, but no matching title appeared in {app}, Radarr or Sonarr.

requests.progress_chip_downloading.description: Requests area, progress. Chip on a poster: downloading, with the percent done. {n} is 0 to 100.

requests.progress_chip_finishing.description: Requests area, progress. Chip on a poster: the download is wrapping up.

requests.progress_chip_importing.description: Requests area, progress. Chip on a poster: being moved into the library.

requests.progress_chip_imported.description: Requests area, progress. Chip on a poster: added to the library.

requests.progress_chip_queued.description: Requests area, progress. Chip on a poster: waiting in the download queue.

requests.progress_chip_paused.description: Requests area, progress. Chip on a poster: the download is paused.

requests.progress_chip_attention.description: Requests area, progress. Chip on a poster: the download app reported a problem.
